# Module Map — idle-base

<!-- generated by /kb-generate — last_crawl_commit: ece8760a02e784dba77a283ca07e2c1a39273b81 -->

151 files tracked by the crawl, 119 of them `.js` under `src/`. Single webpack bundle, no
server. The three-way split below
(`data` → config, `engine` → logic, `components` → render) is the load-bearing convention in
the repo; violating it is the most common way a change gets rejected.

| Path | Responsibility | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `src/index.js`, `src/App.js` | Mount point. `createRoot` → `GameProvider` → `AppShell`. | 8 and 13 lines. Nothing lives here. |
| `src/state/` | The store. `GameContext` (useReducer over whole game), `gameReducer` (flat switch), `actionTypes`, `initialState`. | `initialState.js` documents the null-vs-empty-slice rule. Read it before adding a slice. |
| `src/state/actions/` | 14 pure `(state, action) => state` modules, one per feature area. | Returning the *same object reference* means "refused"; callers depend on this. |
| `src/engine/` | 32 pure simulation modules. No React, no DOM, no `Date.now()`, no bare `Math.random()` (rng arrives as a defaulted parameter). | The heart of the codebase. `tickEngine.js` is the only place simulation happens. |
| `src/data/` | 25 config modules. Every tunable number, every string of player-facing prose. Zero logic. | Comments carry measured simulation results justifying values — these are the design record. |
| `src/components/` | 37 React components across 17 feature folders. Render only; decide nothing. | Each shop panel renders its engine's `listOffers()` verbatim. |
| `src/components/layout/` | `AppShell` (panel routing + act gating), `HeaderStats`, `TabNav`, `EventFeed`. | `AppShell`'s `PANELS` keys must match feature ids in `acts.js` `unlocks`. |
| `src/components/common/` | `Modal`, `Button`, `StatBar`, `CurrencyDisplay`, `ToastHost`. | `ToastHost` derives toasts from state transitions and never stores them — deliberate, see its header. |
| `src/hooks/` | `useGameTick` only: 1s TICK, 30s autosave, offline catch-up on mount, save on hide/unload. | The single timer in the app. |
| `src/persistence/` | `saveLoad.js` — localStorage read/write, version gate. | **No migration by design**: a version mismatch discards the save. |
| `src/utils/` | `formatNumber`, `randomUtils` (`pick`, `randInt`, `jitter`, `generateId`), `statUtils` (`clamp`). | Small and stable. |
| `src/styles/global.css` | The entire stylesheet, 2560 lines. Dark-green ballpark palette. | Organised into feature sections at the end; **the file's last block is an `@media (max-width: 640px)` query**, so appending at EOF silently scopes a rule to mobile. |
| `docs/` | `PRD-incremental-odyssey.md` (710 lines) and design docs. | The PRD the six-act structure implements. |
| `openspec/` | Architectural decision records for the repo. | Created by `/kb-generate`; untracked unless the owner commits it. |
| `public/`, `dist/` | HTML template; webpack output (gitignored). | |
| `.github/` | GitHub Pages deploy. | |

## Engine modules by role

**Simulation core** — `tickEngine` (advance loop), `gameSim` (the one probability model),
`standings`, `schedule`, `playoffs`, `gameReplay` (beat-by-beat on-field narration),
`offlineProgress`, `pacing` (`gameSpeedMult`, the only modifier that divides a duration).

**Rules & progression** — `modifiers` (`resolveRules` + `computeModifiers`), `progression`
(act transitions, exit predicates, initializers, `getUnlockedFeatures`), `prestige`.

**Act-specific** — `lotShop` (I), `wallBall` + `wallBallShop` (II), `littleLeague` (III),
`travelBall` + `sponsorships` + `bookie` (IV), `capsShop` (V+).

**Roster & economy** — `playerFactory`, `strength` (`STAT_WEIGHTS`, `playerOverall`),
`trainingCamp`, `retirement`, `tradeDeadline`, `walkupSongs`, `wallet`, `income`, `economy`,
`concessions`, `clicker`, `identity` (team name), `feed`.

## Cross-cutting seams

Changes that touch these files affect everything; they are where parallel work collides.

- `src/state/gameReducer.js` and `actionTypes.js` — every feature adds a case here.
- `src/state/initialState.js` — every feature adds a slice.
- `src/engine/tickEngine.js` — the simulation core; several features need a hook in `advance()`.
- `src/engine/modifiers.js` + `src/data/modifierKeysConfig.js` — the bonus-key vocabulary.
- `src/data/acts.js` — act rules, unlocks and pacing; nearly every feature registers something.
- `src/styles/global.css` — one file for the whole app.
